justification: Traces the SYMPTOM path exhaustively and correctly (skip-and-continue at openStoreFiles, the trailer version check) and states the root cause as 'the HFile trailer of .../cf/1553916852809385968 is corrupt'. It never asks how an unreadable file came to be in the live column-family directory: 0 mentions of the flush promotion (writeSnapshotFile) or the compaction promotion (installCompactionResult), and 0 mentions of compaction at all. Neither site the fix changed is named, so neither the lines nor the branch condition of the fix are matched.
claimed_branches: catch(IOException) around createReader() -> LOG.warn + continue, so the region opens without the file
gt_lines: Store.internalFlushCache (anon FamilyStore.writeSnapshotFile) Store.java:521-533 - fs.rename(writer.getPath(), dstPath) promotes the flushed file into the live column-family dir at line 526; sf.createReader() only reads it at 533 (fix inserts validateStoreFile(writer.getPath()) at 523, before the rename)

Store.completeCompaction (anon FamilyStore.installCompactionResult) Store.java:1221-1232 - StoreFile.rename(...) promotes the compaction output at 1224-1225 inside 'if (compactedFile != null)'; result.createReader() only reads it at 1232 (fix inserts validateStoreFile(compactedFile.getPath()) at 1222, before the rename)
gt_branches: flush path: the move out of .tmp is guarded only by 'if (!fs.rename(...))' i.e. 'did the rename succeed', never by 'can the file be opened'
compaction path: the move is guarded only by 'if (compactedFile != null)' plus a catch on rename failure, never by 'can the file be opened'

in both: the open (createReader) happens AFTER the move, so an unreadable file is already a permanent member of the store directory; the required guard is 'opens successfully -> promote, else keep it in .tmp'
bar: PASS = both root-cause sites (flush promotion AND compaction promotion) + the exact missing-validation condition; no partial credit (METHODOLOGY §8, §10). Pre-registered in private/ground_truth.md before the runs.
